title: The shovel and the chicken coop

probes.question: Which word would the patient choose to go with the snowy field?
True or false: asked why they chose the shovel, the patient's response would relate to the chicken.

image.alt: A brain drawn as two halves, one teal and one orange, joined by a small dark bridge across a gap.

panels.text: In split-brain, the corpus callosum connecting the two hemispheres of the brain is severed to some degree.
A patient with split brain is shown a picture of a chicken foot and a snowy field in separate visual fields, and asked to choose from a list of words the best association with the pictures.
The patient would choose a chicken to associate with the chicken foot and a shovel to associate with the snow.
But when asked to reason why the patient chose the shovel, the response would relate to the chicken: “the shovel is for cleaning out the chicken coop”.
